answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint cheap voting keys from one purse and treat each clone as an independent household. Mechanism: seal 52 POA in a personal copper vault for 14 epochs, then collect lantern endorsements from 3 vault-holders at least 6 hops apart. A second sibling needs another 52 POA seal plus 3 unused disjoint lantern paths. Verification: peers replay the lock transaction and walk each lantern path, rejecting any repeated endorser. Failure: two vaults that share more than one endorser, or unlock early, lose 55% of the sealed copper; sloppy lantern-holders each forfeit 12 POA.
